Felipe e Rodrigo's "Pós - Ao Vivo" is No. 12 on the Spotify global weekly chart, up 7 places, with 18.1M streams (week of Oct 29, 2026), in only its third week. That's more than Olivia Rodrigo's "stupid song" (No. 15, 17.5M).

The Brazilian sertanejo duo recorded it live, and it is the highest Brazilian song on this week's global chart.

Is sertanejo the next global sound? 👇

Data: Spotify global weekly chart via kworb · week of Oct 29, 2026
